protocol.scope: Synthetic solved 2D static membrane BVP, actual runtime energy/gradient/GN blocks vs independent assembled/solved linear CST. Hard benchmark Dirichlet constraints, not authored-join support.
protocol.initialPose: zero displacement independently for every load; no oracle displacement initialization or continuation
protocol.plane: sheet [u,v] maps to world [u,0,-v]; restrict 3D GN to x/z before solving; no mass/bending/epsilon regularization, timestep or sleep
protocol.boundaries: full left u/v clamp plus right horizontal reference-edge dead traction; aligned 0/90 Poisson-compatible roller control separately labeled
protocol.material: synthetic E1=5.5e9,E2=2.5e9 microN/mm^2,t=.1mm,G12=.387sqrt(E1E2), explicit nu12=.293; stock Poisson convention unresolved
protocol.loadWindowScope: base failures remain visible; fourfold is a separately labeled load-amplitude study of the finite-strain/absolute-position-precision window, with identical material and numerical/accuracy thresholds
protocol.forceTolerance: max(1e-7 microN,1e-10*maximum nodal Euclidean applied load); exact free gradient residual; fixed reactions only, current moment for runtime/reference moment for linear oracle
protocol.nonFiniteEncoding: invalid nonfinite numbers retained as {nonFinite:label}, never silently accepted as zero/null
